sloka: किं तु पूर्वं गतास्म्येका महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः ।पुलस्त्यस्याश्रमं दिव्यमन्वेष्टुं स्वसखीजनम् ।। ७.२.२१ ॥
transliteration: kiṁ tu pūrvaṁ gatāsmyekā maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ ।pulastyasyāśramaṁ divyamanveṣṭuṁ svasakhījanam ।। 7.2.21 ॥

translations.english: However, she continued, previously she had gone alone to the divine hermitage of the great sage Pulastya, whose soul was purified, to search for her female companions.
